title: Weeknight Tomato Pasta
description: A 20-minute pantry pasta that tastes like you fussed. Sweet garlic, a tin of good tomatoes, and a glug of olive oil.

instructions.text: Bring a large pot of salted water to the boil and cook the spaghetti until just shy of al dente.
Meanwhile, warm the olive oil over medium-low heat and gently fry the garlic and chili flakes until fragrant but not browned.
Add the tomatoes, crushing them with a spoon. Simmer 10 minutes until thickened, seasoning with salt.
Drain the pasta, reserving a cup of water. Toss the pasta through the sauce with a splash of the water to emulsify. Finish with basil.

title: Brown Butter Chocolate Chip Cookies
description: Nutty browned butter and a long rest give these deep toffee notes and crackly tops. Worth the wait.

instructions.text: Brown the butter in a saucepan until it smells nutty and turns amber. Cool 10 minutes.
Whisk the butter with both sugars, then beat in the eggs and vanilla until glossy.
Fold in the flour and baking soda, then the chocolate. Chill the dough at least 1 hour (overnight is better).
Scoop onto lined trays and bake at 180C for 11-13 minutes until the edges set but centres look underdone.

title: Smoky Black Bean Tacos
description: Crispy-edged black beans with chipotle, lime, and quick-pickled onion. A reliable Tuesday.

instructions.text: Toss the sliced onion with the lime juice and a pinch of salt; set aside to quick-pickle.
Fry the beans in oil over high heat with the cumin and chipotle until the edges crisp, mashing some for texture.
Pile the beans onto warm tortillas. Top with avocado and the pickled onion.

title: Lemony Greek Chicken Soup
description: Avgolemono — silky egg-and-lemon broth with orzo and shredded chicken. Comfort in a bowl.

instructions.text: Bring the stock to a simmer and cook the orzo until tender. Stir in the shredded chicken.
Whisk the eggs with the lemon juice. Slowly ladle in a cup of hot broth while whisking constantly to temper.
Pour the egg mixture back into the pot off the heat, stirring until silky. Do not boil. Finish with dill and pepper.

title: Sheet-Pan Harissa Salmon
description: Salmon and chickpeas roasted on one tray with harissa and lemon. Dinner with one pan to wash.

instructions.text: Heat the oven to 220C. Toss the chickpeas with half the harissa and the oil on a sheet pan; roast 10 minutes.
Rub the salmon with the remaining harissa, nestle it among the chickpeas, and add the lemon halves cut-side down.
Roast 10-12 minutes until the salmon flakes. Squeeze over the roasted lemon and scatter with parsley.

title: Overnight Oats, Three Ways
description: A base recipe plus three flavour riffs. Five minutes the night before, breakfast sorted all week.

instructions.text: Stir everything together in a jar, cover, and refrigerate overnight.
Apple-cinnamon: add grated apple and a pinch of cinnamon. Berry: fold in mashed berries. PB-banana: swirl in peanut butter and sliced banana.
Top with anything crunchy in the morning and eat cold.
